summary: Homes within 4 to 10 m of the wide end; the rest is narrow and steep.
reasons: Beyond 20 m narrow, tree-lined and steep
No room to pull off past the bend

drivers.seclusion: Pool house is 4 m and another home 10 m from the start of the kerb; further along homes sit 8 to 9 m away at 34 m and 53 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide road with cars parked at the start; from about 20 m it narrows to a bend with trees and bank and no level verge.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with some through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park at the wide end; none on the narrow bend.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m along the whole stretch
Gate 215 m away has a way round it
sun_shade: Garden trees shade the north side; open sky over the road at the wide end.
